note: spring5-security-batch: WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter (removed in Security 6) → a SecurityFilterChain bean with the lambda DSL (authorizeHttpRequests / requestMatchers / formLogin / csrf) — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter` (df607b0899) / `compile|method_does_not_override|configure` (de7e22c12f) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|authorizeRequests` (2df7b3d8e0)
response:
<analysis>Spring Security 6 removed WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter and the authorizeRequests / antMatchers / and() DSL. The configuration becomes a SecurityFilterChain @Bean built from HttpSecurity with the lambda DSL: authorizeHttpRequests + requestMatchers, formLogin(form -> …), csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable()). The DSL chain is project specific, so the script replaces exactly this configure(HttpSecurity) method (it logs and changes nothing when the method differs) and drops the adapter base class.</analysis>
<script>
OLD_METHOD = """    @Override
    protected void configure(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http.authorizeRequests()
                .antMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
                .antMatchers("/batch/**").hasAnyRole("ADMIN", "OPERATOR")
                .anyRequest().authenticated()
                .and()
            .formLogin()
                .loginPage("/login").permitAll()
                .and()
            .csrf().disable();
    }"""
NEW_METHOD = """    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http.authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                .requestMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
                .requestMatchers("/batch/**").hasAnyRole("ADMIN", "OPERATOR")
                .anyRequest().authenticated())
            .formLogin(form -> form
                .loginPage("/login").permitAll())
            .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable());
        return http.build();
    }"""
ADAPTER_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter;"
NEW_IMPORTS = ("import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;",
               "import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;")


def fix(p):
    done = set()
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if not path or path in done or not p.exists(path):
            continue
        done.add(path)
        text = p.read(path)
        if OLD_METHOD not in text:
            p.log(f"{path}: configure(HttpSecurity) differs from the reviewed one - not changed")
            continue
        new = text.replace(OLD_METHOD, NEW_METHOD)
        new = new.replace(" extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter", "")
        new = new.replace(ADAPTER_IMPORT + "\n", "")
        anchor = "import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;"
        missing = [imp for imp in NEW_IMPORTS if imp not in new]
        if missing:
            new = new.replace(anchor, anchor + "\n" + "\n".join(missing), 1)
        p.write(path, new)
        p.log(f"{path}: WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter -> SecurityFilterChain bean (lambda DSL)")
</script>
